records.title: WeSEAL: Well-calibrated Search for Eliminating Attention-sink Leakage
records.reason: The ACM primary publisher endpoint exposed only article metadata/abstract in this attempt; no full text or PDF sections were retrievable, leaving the calibration-versus-throughput results and evaluation conditions unverified.

records.title: SCOPE: Scalable Cross-Task Orthogonal Progressive Experts for Multi-Task Learning in Recommendations
records.reason: SCOPE is a multi-task recommendation training architecture and does not concern LLM inference or serving.

records.title: A Cost-Efficient AI Copilot for High-Volume E-commerce Customer Support
records.reason: AgentChat Copilot reports lower human-agent average handling time and operational savings. The abstract does not report a reduction in LLM inference latency, token cost, memory, or serving resources.

records.title: rerankers: A Lightweight Unified Toolkit for Reranking Approaches
records.reason: This is a toolkit for reranking methods; the abstract does not establish an LLM inference or serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: From Existence to Exhaustiveness: Unveiling the Compounding Failures of LLMs in Multi-answer Event Temporal Reasoning
records.reason: The work measures LLM temporal-reasoning failures and task performance; it proposes no inference-time efficiency method.
